name: scikit-image
summary: scikit-image allows limited AI help for code contributions, such as exploring the codebase, fixing trivial bugs, or automating mechanical tasks, provided contributors disclose AI use, take responsibility, and ensure copyright compliance. AI-written pull request descriptions and issue or PR comments are not permitted.

evidence.quote: Creating novel code (algorithmic additions, writing tests, etc.)
For exploring the codebase, for iterating on hand-written code, and for fixing trivial bugs.
Always declare tool usage: say specifically what part of the task you used AI for in the PR description.
Writing pull request descriptions, or commenting on issues or PRs.
Write PR descriptions and comments by hand.

sources.title: How to contribute to scikit-image — skimage 0.26.1rc0.dev0 documentation
